target.title: feat: support GCP broker metadata auth
target.body:
## Summary

- allow the GCP broker provider to use the Google metadata server when `CRABBOX_GCP_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE=metadata` is set
- keep service-account-key auth working by default when both `GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL` and `GCP_PRIVATE_KEY` are configured
- fail clearly for partial key-pair config or keyless config without the explicit metadata credential source
- update GCP provider readiness and brokered auth docs for metadata-server / Workload Identity deployments
- add Worker regression tests for metadata auth and GCP readiness

Refs https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/1016

## Config and secret implications

Google-hosted coordinators can use the attached service account identity by setting `CRABBOX_GCP_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE=metadata` plus `GCP_PROJECT_ID` or `CRABBOX_GCP_PROJECT`. Portable coordinators keep using `GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL` and `GCP_PRIVATE_KEY`; if either key variable is set, both must be set. Project-only GCP config remains not configured unless the metadata credential source is explicitly selected.

## Verification

- `npm test -- --run test/gcp.test.ts test/fleet.test.ts`
- `npm run format:check`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run check`
- `npm run check:node`
- `GOPATH=/tmp/go-path-crabbox GOMODCACHE=/tmp/go-mod-cache-crabbox GOCACHE=/tmp/go-cache-crabbox scripts/check-docs.sh`
- `npm test`
- `HOME=/tmp/crabbox-home npm run build`
- `npm run build:node`

Internal tracking: ref REI-2531
